name: fundadmin

install.scope: Public marketplace commands refer to the published 1.0.2 baseline, not the unpublished local candidate. See README for the reviewed local-checkout route.
install.cowork: Customize > Plugins > Add marketplace > davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills > install FundAdmin AI

invocation.auto: Hosts also pick a skill from its description when a user shares a fund document and describes the task.

host_qualification.claude_code: Primary target: installed Claude Code 2.1.278; exact-candidate evidence requires an explicit model trace and all 14 saved cases. Consult the verification record; packaging is not a runtime pass.
host_qualification.codex: Supported package format; runtime experimental/unverified. Direct inline evidence only, not an installed-host matrix.
host_qualification.private_evidence: Approved storage outside plugin build inputs.

disclaimer: Document analysis and drafting support only; not financial, legal or tax advice.

skills.name: fund
skills.description: Main menu and router for the 62 FundAdmin AI skills: fund document review, notice drafting, compliance, negotiation, tracking, analytics, intake and reporting. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user types bare `/fund` or `/fundadmin:fund` with no subcommand — load it via the Skill tool and emit the full 62-command menu (including review-lpa, review-capital-call, draft-capital-call, report-pdf) in the same turn. Also use when the user asks what the fund administration assistant can do, lists commands, or asks for a fund admin task without naming a skill. Route `/fund <cmd>` and `/fundadmin:fund <cmd>` (including wire-verify) to the matching fund-<cmd> skill via the Skill tool.

agents.name: fund-terms
agents.description: Terms and provisions analyst for the /fund review-lpa pipeline (methodology v2: 20/80 (25%)). Use to extract and categorize every defined term, fee, waterfall, governance, reporting, LP-protection, capital, transfer and confidentiality provision from an LPA or fund document; its output feeds the risk, compliance, obligations and recommendations agents.

agents.name: fund-risks
agents.description: Risk assessment analyst for the /fund review-lpa pipeline (methodology v2: 25/80 (31.25%)). Use to score each LPA provision 1-10 for GP-favorability, LP exposure, enforceability and deviation from market standard, and to rank the highest-risk provisions; consumes the terms agent output.

agents.name: fund-compliance
agents.description: Regulatory compliance analyst for the /fund review-lpa pipeline (methodology v2: 20/80 (25%)). Use to check an LPA or fund document against SEC, ERISA, FATCA/CRS, AML/KYC, AIFMD and SFDR requirements and to flag missing or non-compliant provisions; consumes the terms agent output.

agents.name: fund-obligations
agents.description: Obligations and timeline analyst for the /fund review-lpa pipeline (methodology v2: 15/80 (18.75%)). Use to map every obligation, capital activity trigger, notice period, cure period, reporting deadline, key person trigger and LPAC consent requirement in an LPA into an operational timeline with financial exposure; consumes the terms agent output.

agents.name: fund-recommendations
agents.description: Recommendations analyst for the /fund review-lpa pipeline (unscored synthesis). Use last: it consumes the terms, risk, compliance and obligations outputs and produces priority-ranked negotiation points, alternative language and action items with market-standard comparisons for the LPA review report.
